The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#569; borg-reborn-rs #667). Pilot (RULES 16) on
classes-18, six arms, 18 starts each (108 games), all classes. Caveat stated up front: borg-reborn-rs #665 (one aged
"known" test, so a dead monster is not hunted) is open; in the on-sight arms a dead dangerous town monster may still be
chased, and the report says how often.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; shipped plays as main 12c4ce7c; every cell ends
in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart; frozen-turn bursts classified.
Report per arm and class: deaths and causes (deaths in town apart), CL at death, final and maximum level, deepest level;
paired rescued and newly killed against shipped (exact McNemar), identical plays; per game the kills of the four dangerous
town monsters (veteran, mercenary, squint-eyed rogue, urchin), thefts, and the first divergent action where kill on sight
alone kills fewer of the four than no kill on sight, at N 6 and N 11 (question 2 of #667: does the damage-term bonus point
the Borg at them in a way that costs something else). Descriptive (RULES 14).
